mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) indicates a reduction in inflationary pressures, leading to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPI decreases by >0.5% and S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE increases by >0.3% and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) indicates a strengthening demand for housing, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases and S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a reduction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO decreases by >1% and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS increases by >0.25% and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) combined with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases by >0.1% and UNRATE decreases by >0.1% in 1 month
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases by >0.1% and S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) indicates a strengthening consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases and S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in GDP (GDPC1) combined with an increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) signals stagflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 decreases by >0.5% and CPIAUCSL increases by >0.5% in 1 quarter
failure_condition: If GDPC1 decreases and CPIAUCSL increases by >0.5% and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances over a 3-year rolling window.
